ideas.title: Compare photos full screen
ideas.body: In Journey › Progress Photos › Compare, tap a photo to see it full screen. Swipe between the two, and pinch or double-tap to zoom.

ideas.title: Compare photos Above and Below
ideas.body: A new Compare layout that stacks the two photos, made for full-length shots.

ideas.title: Compare These Two is always in reach
ideas.body: The Compare These Two button no longer hides behind the tab bar, or off screen when your iPhone or iPad is sideways.
